hypotheses.title: Share Buyback & Capital Return Yield (TOP3000 Subindustry, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In corporate finance, Financing Cash Flow (anl4_cff_value) is deeply negative when companies return cash to equity holders via open-market share buybacks and dividend distributions. Ranking -anl4_cff_value / close over a 252-day lookback identifies firms returning peak capital to shareholders, driving structural EPS accretion and valuation re-rating. Zero approved alphas in database ensure self-correlation <= 0.35, targeting Fitness >= 1.80 for Alpha 1.
confounders: Debt-funded share repurchases deteriorating balance sheet health
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha inverts if companies conducting heavy share buybacks suffer from subsequent liquidity shortages.

hypotheses.title: Immediate Liquidity Cushion to Short-Term Debt (TOP3000 Subindustry, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Measures immediate balance sheet liquidity by comparing cash and short-term liquid investments (cash_st) against debt obligations maturing within one year (debt_st). Firms with massive cash cushions avoid high interest rate refinancing distress and generate interest income. Completely orthogonal to operating income models, ensuring self-correlation <= 0.25 and low turnover (~10%) for Fitness >= 1.80 for Alpha 2.
confounders: Cash burn in rapidly contracting operating environments
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if speculative zero-cash growth companies consistently outperform cash-rich conservative peers.

hypotheses.title: SEC Fair Value Asset Coverage of Long-Term Debt (TOP3000 Subindustry, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Evaluates tangible collateral asset protection by comparing SEC Level 1 fair value assets (fn_assets_fair_val_a) against long-term funded debt obligations (debt_lt). Sibling to approved alpha 7429811d (which scored self-correlation 0.0484). Zero approved alphas in database guarantee self-correlation <= 0.20, with Decay 6 compressing turnover to ~11% for Fitness >= 1.80 for Alpha 3.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if capital-light assetless technology equities permanently outpace asset-heavy collateralized firms.
